blockers: The intended card/coin flourish is not clearly readable in the supplied gesture strip; the hands mostly read as tiny white pixels with no identifiable prop or action.
The torso-to-leg transition is structurally ambiguous at native scale. The broad dark waist and extreme raised-knee pose create the impression of a detached upper body mounted over disconnected legs.

Facial construction is below professional 128px readability: the eyes are uneven and overly isolated, while the face lacks a clean nose, cheek, or hat-shadow structure to establish a stable expression.
The animation set has insufficient visible anticipation, overshoot, and settle. The idle strip appears nearly static, and the gesture strip does not establish a convincing flourish arc.
Several locomotion poses rely on the same lifted-leg silhouette, causing the character to read as perpetually hopping rather than transferring weight through a jaunty gait.
high_value_changes: Redesign the waist and coat junction with a deliberate vest, belt, and duster overlap so the torso, pelvis, and legs remain legible as one connected body at native 1x.

Make the signature prop explicit: enlarge the card fan or coin cluster by a few pixels, give it a high-contrast shape, and stage the hand path around it rather than leaving it embedded in the hand highlights.
Rebuild the face using a consistent two-eye spacing, controlled hat shadow, and one strong asymmetry such as a smirk or narrowed eye; avoid isolated square eye pixels.
Add a readable gesture timing pattern: preparation with the elbow pulled back, clear extension and prop reveal, one-frame overshoot, then a held settle pose.
Rework locomotion so each direction has a planted support foot, visible compression, and a distinct passing pose. Reduce repeated bent-knee frames and verify that shoe contacts do not visually slide.

Increase value separation between the emerald coat, black trousers, and dark background. The coat needs a cleaner shadow family and the trousers need a brighter edge or seam to prevent the lower body from collapsing into one black mass.
optional_notes: The hat silhouette, violet ribbon, crimson vest, and broken diagonal leg pose give the Gambler a useful theatrical identity.

Against Celina, the emerald/crimson/violet palette is sufficiently separated from her blue/black palette. The main convergence is body proportion: both remain tall, narrow, humanoid figures with compact torsos and long straight legs.

The Gambler's silhouette is more angular and asymmetrical than Celina's, but the raised-leg pose is doing too much of the differentiation. Preserve the hat and coat geometry so the character remains recognizable in neutral poses.
Technical validation is clean: the 123.3px standing height and zero anchor drift satisfy the stated contract, but technical compliance does not resolve the visual weight and readability problems.
regressions_from_previous: No prior Gambler round sheet was supplied, so frame-level regressions from earlier Gambler iterations cannot be verified.

Relative to the accepted Celina comparison, the Gambler does not show palette convergence, but its long-legged narrow body plan still partially converges with the roster's existing upright humanoid proportions.

The supplied comparison does not demonstrate a stronger neutral-pose identity than the prior roster; the Gambler's distinction is concentrated in the hat and raised-leg silhouette rather than distributed across the whole design.
strongest_improvements: The hat brim and violet ribbon provide an immediately recognizable head silhouette.
The crimson vest against emerald sleeves establishes a strong theatrical color hierarchy.
The asymmetrical raised-leg stance creates a clear starting point for a slippery, jaunty personality.
Zero ground-anchor drift and compliant standing height provide a sound technical foundation for further animation work.
luna_evaluation.single_most_important_next_change: Rebuild the signature gesture and lower-body connection as one readable action: show a clearly identifiable card or coin flourish while correcting the waist-to-pelvis silhouette and adding planted support-foot timing.
